title: Searching for New Z-DNA/Z-RNA Binding Proteins Based on Structural Similarity to Experimentally Validated Zalpha Domain.
authors: Bartas, Martin; Slychko, Kristyna; Brazda, Vaclav; Cerven, Jiri; Beaudoin, Christopher A; Blundell, Tom L; Pecinka, Petr
one_liner_zh: 该文基于结构相似性搜索和分子对接预测新的Z-DNA/Z-RNA结合蛋白，属于广义蛋白-核酸互作且方法可迁移，但非典型TF-DNA体系，深度有限。
abstract: Z-DNA and Z-RNA are functionally important left-handed structures of nucleic acids, which play a significant role in several molecular and biological processes including DNA replication, gene expression regulation and viral nucleic acid sensing. Most proteins that have been proven to interact with Z-DNA/Z-RNA contain the so-called Zalpha domain, which is structurally well conserved. To date, only eight proteins with Zalpha domain have been described within a few organisms (including human, mouse, Danio rerio, Trypanosoma brucei and some viruses). Therefore, this paper aimed to search for new Z-DNA/Z-RNA binding proteins in the complete PDB structures database and from the AlphaFold2 protein models. A structure-based similarity search found 14 proteins with highly similar Zalpha domain structure in experimentally-defined proteins and 185 proteins with a putative Zalpha domain using the AlphaFold2 models. Structure-based alignment and molecular docking confirmed high functional conservation of amino acids involved in Z-DNA/Z-RNA, suggesting that Z-DNA/Z-RNA recognition may play an important role in a variety of cellular processes.
abstract_zh: Z-DNA和Z-RNA是核酸的功能性重要左手结构，在多种分子和生物学过程中发挥重要作用，包括DNA复制、基因表达调控及病毒核酸感知。已被证实与Z-DNA/Z-RNA相互作用的多数蛋白质含有所谓的Zalpha结构域，该结构域在结构上高度保守。迄今为止，仅在少数生物体（包括人类、小鼠、斑马鱼、布氏锥虫及一些病毒）中描述了八种含Zalpha结构域的蛋白质。因此，本文旨在从完整的PDB结构数据库和AlphaFold2蛋白质模型中搜索新的Z-DNA/Z-RNA结合蛋白。基于结构的相似性搜索在实验确定的蛋白质中发现了14种具有高度相似Zalpha结构域的蛋白质，并利用AlphaFold2模型识别出185种具有推定Zalpha结构域的蛋白质。基于结构的比对和分子对接证实了参与Z-DNA/Z-RNA的氨基酸具有高度功能保守性，提示Z-DNA/Z-RNA识别可能在多种细胞过程中发挥重要作用。
